items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Sister Katie wrote, Mama's Gone Goodbye.

ctx.x: But that was after Alvin wrote you. He used to write music. We bought some of his music.
I can't remember. Sister Katie wrote, Mama's Gone Goodbye. Here on, let's see. Blue Orleans Wiggle, I think he did that one.

And that Purple Rose of Cairo is theme song. No. Our theme song was Say a Little Prayer to Me. Was what? Say a Little Prayer for Me. That was our theme song. Oh, I wanted to get some of the early, you know? I didn't know. I didn't know. I didn't know. I didn't know. I didn't know. I didn't know.
